name: Summer@Carroll
description_short: A five-week summer school (June 30 to August 3, 2027) for students entering grades 1-9 who have been diagnosed with language-based learning difficulties such as dyslexia. Mornings are small-group academic classes in reading, spelling, writing and math with Orton-Gillingham trained tutors; afternoons are enrichment and outdoor play. Grades 1-4 meet in Waltham, grades 5-9 in Lincoln.
special_needs_notes: The program is built for students diagnosed with specific learning difficulties in reading and writing, such as dyslexia. Teachers work to each student's needs, from teaching decoding to getting students ready for high school.

warnings: The program runs on two campuses. Grades 1-4 are at 1841 Trapelo Road, Waltham, MA 02451. Grades 5-9 are at 25 Baker Bridge Road, Lincoln, MA 01773. The main address recorded is Waltham.
Each grade group has a single program running the full June 30 to August 3 period, with no programs on Monday, July 5. The page does not show any weekly sessions.
Grades 1-2 run 8:30am-2:30pm, with Extended Day to 4:00pm for an extra fee. Grades 3-9 run 8:30am-4:00pm.

This is a summer school for students with diagnosed learning differences. Students attend during the day and go home each night. It is recorded as 'specialty', but it could also be filed as a day program.
The page says nothing about prices.
